headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update| Sector: Iron & Steel Products SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key Highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Robust performance driven by strong sales volume growth.
(JTLIND) during 2QFY27 reported Revenue/EBITDA/PAT growth of 43.0%/46.5%/30.7% YoY to Rs 614 cr/Rs 51 cr/Rs 29 cr, respectively.
The company registered sales volume of 1,00,484 MT during the quarter, up 23.2% YoY, while for 1HFY27, JTLIND posted record sales volume of 2,18,997 MT, up 20.2% YoY.
EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 8.3%, registering a 20 bps expansion on a YoY basis.
valuation: Ultimately, management targets reducing working capital days to 60 days in FY28 and 35 days in FY29.
JTL Defence ramp-up: Production run-rate increased from 40 tonnes/month at launch to 140 tonnes/month in Oct’26, with further ramp-up targeted to 250 tonnes/month by Dec’26.

Maintain BUY- Target Rs 126.2/- Based on SOTP valuation approach, we value JTLIND’s core business at a target P/E multiple of 18x based on FY28E EPS of Rs 6.4 to arrive at a fair value of Rs 115.5 per share.
watch: Result Update| Sector: Iron & Steel Products SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key Highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Robust performance driven by strong sales volume growth.
Management is actively reducing exposure to government contracts to de-risk the balance sheet & accelerate cash collection through a dealer-focused distribution model.
